title: Binary Classification with the Maximum Score Model and Linear Programming
abstract: arXiv:2507.19654v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper presents a computationally efficient method for binary classification using Manski's (1975, 1985) maximum score model when covariates are discretely distributed and parameters are partially but not point identified. We establish minimax-regret-optimal classification rules that take account of partial identification of the model's parameters. We bound misclassification probabilities and expected excess regret induced by sampling uncertainty. We also describe an extension of our method to continuous covariates. Our approach avoids the computational difficulty of maximum score estimation by reformulating the problem as two linear programs. Compared to parametric and nonparametric methods, our method balances extrapolation ability with minimal distributional assumptions. Monte Carlo simulations and empirical applications demonstrate its effectiveness and practical relevance.

translated_title: 基于最大得分模型与线性规划的二元分类
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种计算高效的方法，用于在协变量离散分布且参数为部分识别（而非点识别）的情形下，使用 Manski（1975, 1985）的最大得分模型进行二元分类。我们建立了最小化最大遗憾最优的分类规则，该规则考虑了模型参数的部分识别性。我们对由抽样不确定性引起的误分类概率和预期超额遗憾给出了界。我们还描述了该方法向连续协变量的扩展。我们的方法通过将问题重新表述为两个线性规划，避免了最大得分估计的计算困难。与参数方法和非参数方法相比，我们的方法在外推能力与最少的分布假设之间取得了平衡。蒙特卡洛模拟和实证应用证明了该方法的有效性和实际相关性。
tldr: 本文将 Manski 最大得分模型的二元分类问题重新表述为两个线性规划，在参数部分识别下建立了最小化最大遗憾最优的分类规则，并给出了误分类概率和预期超额遗憾的界，兼顾外推能力与最少分布假设。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates binary classification with Manski's maximum score model as two linear programs, establishing minimax-regret-optimal classification rules under partial identification, with bounds on misclassification probability and expected excess regret.
